Give

奉獻

Giving is a Christian’s privilege, responsibility and a channel of blessing. God is pleased when believers give willingly. You can give in the following ways.

奉獻是基督徒的權利ˎ義務和蒙福的管道, 信徒樂意的奉獻，必為神所悅納。大家可以透過以下的途徑進行奉獻:

Give online

網上奉獻

Give through the church’s PayPal donation page.

透過教會的 PayPal 奉獻頁面進行奉獻。

Give with PayPal · 透過 PayPal 奉獻

Give by cheque

支票奉獻

Make your cheque payable to MPCBC and mail it to the church address below.

支票抬頭請寫 MPCBC，郵寄教會地址：

302 W. Commonwealth Ave.
Alhambra, CA 91801

Contact us · 聯絡我們
